title: Perform, speak and reflect
intro: Play a character in an imagined scene. Use words and actions to make the character clear. Explain how you felt about the activity and how a gesture may give a clue about a feeling.
support: په خیالي صحنه کې یو کرکټر تمثیل کړئ. خبرې او کړنې وکاروئ. ووایئ چې تمرین څنګه و او د بدن حرکت څنګه د احساس نښه کېدای شي.
text:
Silent rehearsal
Rafi acts as a visitor: Hello. My name is Rafi.
Mina acts as the host: Welcome! Please sit here.
Rafi smiles and waves.
After the play: I liked welcoming my partner.
model: A wave can be a greeting. A smile can suggest happiness. A movement or expression can give several possible clues. A reflection can explain what you enjoyed or what you would try next.
activity: Read the silent script. Label the speaker of each line. Write one greeting that fits a new role.
adult: Set up a pretend library. Let the learner choose visitor or librarian, take a turn in role and then swap roles. Ask what they enjoyed and what they might change. Record a detail from their performance. Offer words, gesture or an agreed communication aid.

tasks: Act out a greeting as the visitor. Speak clearly.
Choose the host role and welcome a partner.
Show a wave or explain another way to greet someone.
Say your name and one thing you enjoy.
Describe a possible feeling for a smiling character. Give another possibility.
With a partner, act out a visit to a classroom or a shop.
Tell what you liked about your role-play and what you would change.
Act out a new scene with a partner. Show your role through words or actions.
Make a short personal statement about a familiar hobby.
Describe how a character's movement or face might show a feeling. Then tell what you enjoyed about the activity.
